original_ai_output.title_zh: 南苏丹鲁旺行政区遭袭，至少九死六伤
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 南苏丹鲁旺行政区两处地点遭武装袭击，至少9人死亡、6人受伤，另有数百头牛被抢。鲁旺看守政府指责邻州团结州武装青年所为，但团结州方面表示仍在调查，尚未确认袭击者身份。事件为单一来源报道。

location.site: Bhal Payam（湖泊-诺县）与Pochod Boma（阿利尼县阿利朗Payam）
location.raw_text: Bhal Payam in Lake-No County and Pochod Boma in Alilang Payam, Aliny County, Ruweng Administrative Area

key_facts.fact: 鲁旺行政区两处地点遭袭，至少9人死亡、6人受伤
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: At least nine people have been killed and six wounded in attacks on two locations in South Sudan’s Ruweng Administrative Area

key_facts.fact: 袭击发生于周日10月18日晚约11时
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The attacks took place at about 11 p.m. on Sunday, October 18

key_facts.fact: 鲁旺看守政府信息部长称共501头牛被抢、5座牛棚被毁、15间房屋被烧
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: 501 head of cattle were raided, five cattle byres were destroyed and 15 huts were burned

key_facts.fact: 鲁旺方面指责团结州Bul与Leek社区的武装青年发动袭击
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Tony blamed armed youth from the Bul and Leek communities of Unity State for the attacks

key_facts.fact: 团结州看守政府信息部长称当局仍在调查，尚未确认袭击者身份
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: authorities are still investigating the incident and had not established the identities of those responsible
